Globex Gov | https://www.globex-gov.example.test | Remote (U.S. — Eastern/Central Time) | AI, Full Stack, Frontend, SRE & Cloud Automation | U.S. Citizens

Globex Gov is hiring engineers to build secure, production-grade AI and analytics for public-sector missions.

• AI Engineer — AI/ML engineering; Python, LLMs, RAG, embeddings, evaluation, guardrails.

• Full Stack AI Developer — Python + React/TypeScript; secure APIs and enterprise data integrations.

• Frontend Engineer — React + TypeScript for enterprise AI applications.

• SRE Platform Engineer — cloud, Terraform, observability, CI/CD and Kubernetes.

Required for all roles:

U.S. citizenship • Currently residing in the U.S. • Eastern or Central Time Zone • Ability to obtain a government clearance.

Compensation varies by role and experience and we are happy to discuss it early.

To apply, email your resume and GitHub profile to jobs@globex-gov.example.test

Please mention “Hacker News” in the subject line.
